events.title: Banks rescue a large investment fund
events.description: Private banks and securities firms invest in Long-Term Capital Management after heavy losses.

events.title: The euro begins
events.description: Eleven countries adopt a shared currency for financial transactions. Notes and coins come later.

events.title: The September 11 attacks
events.description: Terrorist attacks kill thousands in the United States. Communities mourn and help those affected.

what_happened_next.text:
Amazon more than tripled over five years, leading this set, but its path included very large monthly falls. Apple gained less, while Microsoft lagged both cash and bonds. The US basket and cash ended quite close. The final ranking hides how differently these investments felt along the way.

Soon after the start, banks and securities firms put money into Long-Term Capital Management following heavy losses. The euro began for financial transactions in 1999. The September 11 attacks followed in 2001, causing devastating human losses. The five years contained more than one kind of crisis, alongside ordinary business activity.

Knowing there was trouble at the start was not the same as knowing which investments would recover. A frightening headline could make you want to avoid everything, while an exciting product could pull you toward one company. Neither feeling supplied a reliable five-year ranking. The useful comparison is between your original reasons for choosing and the different paths that the investments actually took.

reflection.what_people_were_focused_on: Russia’s financial crisis unsettled investors. Apple had a new computer, Amazon was adding music, and Microsoft faced a disputed antitrust case.
reflection.what_actually_mattered: The gains and losses along the way mattered as well as the ending value. One fast-changing company could create much sharper swings than cash.
reflection.what_faded_away: A product’s early sales and a legal headline did not give a complete five-year answer. No single story captured everything affecting a company.
reflection.what_nobody_knew: Nobody knew Amazon’s eventual result or the depth of the falls along the way. Its later fame can make a risky starting decision seem obvious in hindsight.
